requirements.statement: While no LL function has been called after reset, the IWDG LL driver shall not write any IWDG register.
requirements.verification: target_robot_test passes when no IWDG register is written

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to start the watchdog, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x0000CCCC to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with 0x0000CCCC

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to refresh the watchdog counter, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x0000AAAA to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with 0x0000AAAA

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to enable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write the value 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with 0x00005555

requirements.statement: When the IWDG LL driver is requested to disable write access to IWDG_PR and IWDG_RLR, the IWDG LL driver shall write any value other than 0x00005555 to IWDG_KR.KEY.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_KR.KEY is written with a value other than 0x00005555

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the provided prescaler divider value to the IWDG_PR.PR field.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_PR.PR is written with a 4-bit value

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall write the reload value to IWDG_RLR.RL when a function sets the watchdog reload value.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_RLR.RL is written with a 12-bit value

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall return 1U when the IWDG_SR.ONF field is set, else 0U.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_SR.ONF is read and returns correct value

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall return 1U when the IWDG_SR.EWU field is set, else 0U.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_SR.EWU is read and returns correct value

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall return 1U when the IWDG_SR.EWIF field is set, else 0U.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_SR.EWIF is read and returns correct value

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall read the IWDG_SR.PVU field to determine if a prescaler value update is ongoing, while the watchdog is active.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_SR.PVU is read

requirements.statement: The IWDG LL driver shall read the IWDG_SR.RVU field to determine if a reload value update is ongoing, while the watchdog is active.
requirements.verification: host_unit_test passes when IWDG_SR.RVU is read
